Geographies Served Programs Building Capacities of Rural Youth in Modern Agriculture and Agribusiness State Andhra Pradesh Telangana States Andhra Pradesh Telangana To leverage the potential of agriculture and its value chains for generating sustainable employment and livelihood opportunities in rural areas, CSFD has commenced entrepreneurship acceleration training programs and Agriculture and agribusiness training programs to foster rural entrepreneurship. This initiative focuses on identifying, training, and supporting rural stakeholders and young talents in their journey toward entrepreneurship through a collaborative effort involving institutions dedicated to promoting rural entrepreneurship. Health and Nutrition District Mahabubnagar Sangareddy State Telangana District Mahabubnagar Sangareddy States Telangana Cornell Sathguru Foundation for Development (CSFD) works with the rural communities of 10 villages in Sangareddy district and 13 villages in Mahbubnagar district Telangana with an aim to improve agriculture practices and to create sustainable livelihood opportunities. CSFD’s one such initiative, developing kitchen gardens focuses on enhancing the nutrition level of communities and providing a platform to create livelihood opportunities. Mostly, the kitchen gardens can be established and maintained on small patch of land or backyard with a variety of assorted vegetables and fruits. These gardens provide the communities with a platform for innovations in supplemental food production as well as an opportunity to improve their livelihoods. fields.description:
About Us 
CSFD is a registered not for profit foundation promoted jointly by Cornell University, USA and Sathguru India. CSFD works to facilitate sustainable social development for enhancing capacities, knowledge creation, promoting entrepreneurship and encouraging gender equality. CSFD brings in expertise from diverse fields and institutions like Cornell
